entities.name: Valyl-tRNA synthetase
observations: The 768-aa query sequence is identified by 100% identity and full query coverage to curated Idiomarina loihiensis ValRS Q5QY15; additional curated homologs show about 74% identity.
ValRS catalyzes ATP-dependent attachment of L-valine to tRNA(Val), producing valyl-tRNA and AMP plus diphosphate; EC 6.1.1.9; Rhea RHEA:10704.
ValRS has post-transfer editing activity that hydrolyzes mischarged Thr-tRNA(Val), supporting translational fidelity.
The sequence contains class-I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase HIGH and KMSKS motifs and Pfam tRNA-synt_1 plus an Anticodon_1 domain at residues 673–762.
Reference proteins are cytosolic and monomeric.
Sequence-derived properties: 768 aa, approximately 88.85 kDa, theoretical pI 5.17, predicted charge at pH 7 about -32.4, instability index 33.1, GRAVY -0.554.

entities.name: Valyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: tRNA(Val) + L-valine + ATP yields L-valyl-tRNA(Val) + AMP + diphosphate; associated with EC 6.1.1.9 and Rhea RHEA:10704.

entities.name: Cytosolic translation
observations: ValRS supports cytosolic protein synthesis by charging tRNA(Val) with valine.
